title: Cliffside Retreat
description:
Cliffside Retreat – 4BR/2BA duplex sleeping 12 with breathtaking Cumberland River views. Enjoy a huge private deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Just minutes to Opry Mills, Opryland & the airport. Quiet, scenic, and convenient—with a shared driveway and your own private entrance.

The space
Cliffside Retreat is the RIGHT-SIDE unit of a duplex, with its own private entrance on the right side of the house (not the front of the house). Inside you'll find 4 bedrooms with four queen beds plus a full sofa bed, 2 bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen with a dining table, and an in-unit washer and dryer. Step out onto the large private deck to take in the Cumberland River views and fire up the outdoor grill. WiFi and a laptop-friendly workspace make remote work easy.

Guest access
You'll have the entire right-side unit of the duplex, including the private deck. Your entrance door is on the RIGHT SIDE of the house, not the front of the house. The left side is home to a long-term resident, so please do not use the front or left side of the house.

Self check-in with a keypad lock. Your personal door code and step-by-step instructions are sent before arrival.

Parking: park on the right side of the driveway turnaround and keep the shared drive clear. Additional street parking is available.

Other things to note
This home is a duplex. Your unit and entrance are on the RIGHT side of the house, not the front. A long-term resident lives on the left side, so please be mindful of noise. Quiet hours are 10 PM to 8 AM. No parties or events. Pets welcome with prior approval and a pet fee.
